**Finding submitted: deviation (medium severity, restrictive covenants).**

Section 19 imposes a mutual **no-hire** — not a non-solicit — barring either party (and its affiliates) from hiring "any employee of the other party" for the term plus one year, with no involvement-based limitation in its first limb and no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. That is a playbook walk-away as drafted, and it binds Sparkling Spring Water Group.

Because the restriction is mutual and already part of the bargain, I redlined to the fallback rather than deleting Section 19: a 12-month non-solicit measured from the end of an individual's involvement, limited to personnel directly involved in the services, with express confirmation that hiring is not prohibited and carve-outs for general recruitment and unsolicited approaches. Survival under Section 18 remains acceptable for the narrowed clause.
